purpose: Frozen task definitions for criterion-by-criterion integration reviews; not an acceptance result. Numerical budgets remain in the separately frozen contact and runtime contracts.

acceptance: Use finite hammer mass, reciprocal contact forces, separation and recontact with persistent resonator state.
Model damper/pedal contact and resting equilibrium; identify or label all assumed contact parameters.
Pass energy, timestep convergence, retrigger, release and pedal stress checks with explicit numerical tolerances.
definition.target: One documented 73-key Mark I Stage specimen at its specified loaded electrical output; identity and measurements pending.

acceptance: Bounded sample-offset event processing preserves producer order and physical key state; invalid blocks reject without mutation.
An optional VST3 instrument builds against an explicitly identified public SDK and passes the available SDK validator with bounded audio processing and documented output scaling.
Host configuration round-trips through a versioned validated state format; MIDI range, sustain, overlapping notes, reset and unsupported host conditions are explicit and tested.
Document the actual tested platform and synthetic sound boundary without claiming measured fidelity or an untested release.
